cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('.docker/infra/keycloak/green-ecolution-realm.json'))
print('realm:',d.get('realm'))
print('clients:',[(c.get('clientId'),c.get('secret')) for c in d.get('clients',[])])
for u in d.get('users',[]):
    print('user:',u.get('username'),'enabled',u.get('enabled'),'creds',[(c.get('type'),c.get('value')) for c in u.get('credentials',[])])
"
